{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:", sales_df.isnull().sum().to_dict())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Customer_age sentinel values:", sales_df['customer_age'].unique())

# Check the structure of the revenue column
print("Revenue data types:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample of revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check the status column
print("Status value counts:", sales_df['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check customer_segment
print("Customer_segment value counts:", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts().to_dict())"}
